turns.prompt: This is an automated test. Compare tea and coffee on caffeine, taste and price in a Markdown table, then give two tips as a bulleted list.
turns.message:
| Aspect | Tea | Coffee |
|---|---|---|
| Caffeine | Usually lower: about 20–70 mg per cup | Usually higher: about 80–120 mg per cup |
| Taste | Lighter, more varied, sometimes herbal or floral | Rich, bold, roasted, and often bitter |
| Price | Often cheaper per serving, especially loose-leaf or tea bags | Can be more expensive, particularly specialty coffee |

- Choose tea if you want gentler stimulation or more flavor variety.
- Choose coffee if you need a stronger caffeine boost and prefer a bold taste.
